title: Planning reads a goal that judges state on origin/main against the command's own unpushed commits, so the clause is not left to a mid-work gate
goal: Found at the SP-m3azo2y7 close: ST-vblulwrc's goal said prune_reopened_refs keeps the ref of an item present on origin/main and also that a removed item's ref is gone, but close and drop commit locally, so origin/main still holds every file they just removed; the worker stopped on blocking gate g3 mid-work to ask which clause wins. kb-sprint plan step 4 or 6 has the planner read a goal clause that judges state on the integration main against the commits the command itself makes before any push, and ask the choice as a gate before the start.
